payload.title: File:Postcranial elements of Presbyornithidae and southern screamer.jpg
payload.artist_html: The original author of this work is De Pietri et al. (2016).
payload.credit_html:
I found this image in the 2016 open access journal published in Royal Society Open Science. The title of this 2016 article is "The unexpected survival of an ancient lineage of anseriform birds into the Neogene of Australia: the youngest record of Presbyornithidae".

https://royalsocietypublishing.org/doi/10.1098/rsos.150635
payload.description_html: Postcranial elements of Wilaru (a, b, c, d, j, k, p, q, r, s, u, x, a′, b′), Presbyornis pervetus (e, h, i, l, n, t, w, z, d′), Teviornis (f, g, m, o) and the southern screamer (v, y, c′)
